reviews.title: Update issues
reviews.text: I love this app, but every time there is an update, I feel like it causes issues and problems in the app.  Please get these updates working properly before pushing them.  This is an app that I use every day to help me stay organized and when it has problems, it has the potential to really impact my day and sometimes I wonder if it’s worth keeping and paying for when there are other free apps like Goodnotes out there. 8/26-I HATE this new update.  It takes more clicks just to enter text.  Why can’t I just tap the space on my page I want to write in, now I have to go to the top and click to “add text” then I have to click where I want it…why are we adding steps? Also, now when I want to adjust the line spacing, I have to “see more” options and it doesn’t even give me a number, just a sliding bar, which isn’t helpful.  I feel like it is getting worse instead of better and I think at the end of the year I need to cancel my subscription and just start using one of the free apps.

reviews.title: Critical regression in user experience and subscription value.
reviews.text:
As a long-term, dedicated user and current premium subscriber, I am profoundly disappointed by the recent shift in Zinnia’s monetization model. Historically, I have valued this app for its seamless creative workflow; however, the recent implementation of aggressive paywalls for core assets—specifically stickers and the creation of new journals—is unacceptable for a paying member.

Existing subscribers choose a premium plan with the expectation of a comprehensive, frictionless experience. By gating features that were previously included, you have effectively diminished the value proposition of the current subscription and disrupted my professional journaling process.

I am requesting a formal clarification: is this a permanent restructuring of premium benefits, or an oversight in the recent update? I would appreciate a prompt response detailing how you plan to restore full accessibility for your paying community. Until this is resolved, the app remains non-functional for my needs.

reviews.title: Nice app let down by Subsciption Model
reviews.text:
At a time when a lot of people are having to cut back on subscriptions due to the cost of living, it is always a shame to see yet another Subscription only app or service.

This is a very nice app but the subscription model is both greedy and unfriendly, I consider this app to be a luxury so I will not be signing up to 1 whole year!

If the owners of this app would let me pay monthly or pay a one time fee for perpetual/lifetime access then I would be happy to pay, I can not however justify paying a full year, okay there is a free trial for 7 days but that is not the same, maybe I need a few months of journaling to really feel if this app fits me and my lifestyle, super anxious also that I will forget to cancel and a full year will be debited. 

Another app ruined by a greedy and inflexible Subscription model!
